SESSION	set spark.sql.parser.quotedRegexColumnNames=false
SESSION	CREATE OR REPLACE TEMPORARY VIEW testData AS SELECT * FROM VALUES
SESSION	CREATE OR REPLACE TEMPORARY VIEW testData2 AS SELECT * FROM VALUES
READ	SELECT `(a)?+.+` FROM testData2 WHERE a = 1
READ	SELECT t.`(a)?+.+` FROM testData2 t WHERE a = 1
READ	SELECT `(a|b)` FROM testData2 WHERE a = 2
READ	SELECT `(a|b)?+.+` FROM testData2 WHERE a = 2
READ	SELECT SUM(`(a|b)?+.+`) FROM testData2
READ	SELECT SUM(`(a)`) FROM testData2
SESSION	set spark.sql.parser.quotedRegexColumnNames=true

READ	SELECT `(A)?+.+` FROM testData2 WHERE a = 1
READ	SELECT t.`(a)?+.+` FROM testData2 t WHERE a = 1
READ	SELECT t.`(A)?+.+` FROM testData2 t WHERE a = 1
READ	SELECT `(a|B)` FROM testData2 WHERE a = 2
READ	SELECT `(A|b)` FROM testData2 WHERE a = 2
READ	SELECT `(a|B)?+.+` FROM testData2 WHERE a = 2
READ	SELECT `(A|b)?+.+` FROM testData2 WHERE a = 2
READ	SELECT `(e|f)` FROM testData2
READ	SELECT t.`(e|f)` FROM testData2 t
READ	SELECT p.`(KEY)?+.+`, b, testdata2.`(b)?+.+` FROM testData p join testData2 ON p.key = testData2.a WHERE key < 3
READ	SELECT p.`(key)?+.+`, b, testdata2.`(b)?+.+` FROM testData p join testData2 ON p.key = testData2.a WHERE key < 3
SESSION	set spark.sql.caseSensitive=true
SESSION	CREATE OR REPLACE TEMPORARY VIEW testdata3 AS SELECT * FROM VALUES
READ	SELECT `(A)?+.+` FROM testdata3
READ	SELECT `(a)?+.+` FROM testdata3
READ	SELECT `(A)?+.+` FROM testdata3 WHERE a > 1
READ	SELECT `(a)?+.+` FROM testdata3 where `a` > 1
READ	SELECT SUM(`a`) FROM testdata3
READ	SELECT SUM(`(a)`) FROM testdata3

READ	SELECT SUM(a) FROM testdata3 GROUP BY `a`
READ	SELECT SUM(a) FROM testdata3 GROUP BY `(a)`
READ	SELECT SUM(a) FROM testdata3 GROUP BY `(a)?+.+`
